{{Quote|See that, Yung? That's confidence.|Herron|<ref name="Under New Management" />}}
'''Herron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]<ref name="Under New Management" /> in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> While stationed in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Sergeant Herron led a squad in an attempt to recover several newly-developed [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] from the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation's]] [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation (facility)|facility]] when Imperial forces seized control of the factory, but the mission was a failure because of bad intelligence on the size of the enemy forces. Herron sought aid from other [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces, who were able to infiltrate the factory and open an access tunnel so that Herron and his subordinate [[Yung]] could lead their unit into the facility and steal the shuttles.<ref name="Under New Management" />
